notes.title: The Stillness of the Wind 85% off in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32557131/0fc12abe1465906f4e54f4a54c5f19280964a492.png

The annual Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale is now on - and to celebrate, The Stillness of the Wind is 85% off! 

➡️ Take me to the Publisher Sale ⬅️

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; Scrabdackle, Wander Stars and Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo - read up on each of them below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif

 Wander Stars: Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
 Scrabdackle: As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
 Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo: A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.So get exploring and grab some great narrative games!

notes.title: The Stillness of the Wind in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32557131/2b310a422807770a4ffdb638c71a931e1340c528.png

Stillness of the Wind is 75% off in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!

Until 10am on Monday June 21st, Fellow Traveller is having their biggest sale yet! Featuring the deepest discounts they'll be offering for the next couple of months on their games, as well as demos available for their upcoming games, and watch developer and gameplay streams! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025617/26e5587a79f761e8592286d4c941a3ff4baefe42.png

Fellow Traveller commissioned the comic book artist Guillaume Singelin to create an illustration inspired by the Fellow Traveller logo as well as three pieces inspired by their games, including one of The Stillness of the Wind!

Join the Fellow Traveller Discord during the event to get your hands on desktop and mobile wallpapers of his art and become part of the Fellow Traveller community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33025617/ad620ebac47c34ce2106c9436a758f0e53c2197a.png

notes.title: The Goats Will Be Ready on February 7th!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32557131/bd6f4aeea6caaac49ee58b3fa27cdd416bcd0b04.gif

The Stillness of the Wind is launching on Steam on February 7th!


We're so stoked to finally announce this release date that we'll be hosting a bit of a victory dance on our weekly livestream, right here on Steam. on Wednesday January 30 at 3pm Pacific Time. We'll be joined by Coyan Cardenas, the solo developer behind Memory of God.

 Get ready to cry over goats.
